summary: Validated Kairos by Zayado bug fixes and multi-role flows. Backend (8/8 pytest passing): POST /api/auth/register creates a client with blank profile (prenom='', onboarded=false, empty priorities/goal) — 'Camille' hardcoded bug is fixed and data isolation confirmed via Bearer token. GET /api/admin/vue-ensemble correctly returns 403 without token and for client (Sara) tokens, and returns {utilisateurs_total, par_role{client,vendeur,admin}} for admin. Login works for sara/admin/vendeur seeds. Frontend: onboarding flow completed with data-testids end-to-end — final step shows 'Offre choisie : Essentielle' and NO 'undefined' (Onboarding.jsx PLANS default fix confirmed). Marketplace correctly gates client (toast 'Réservé aux comptes vendeur' + fallback 'Connecte-toi' message — known non-blocking) and shows full Espace Vendeur UI for test.radar@ (menu 'Mes produits' / 'Profil vendeur', product 'Test produit radar' in Brouillon).

issues: Message 'Connecte-toi avec un compte (lien magique, Google ou Microsoft) pour ouvrir ton espace vendeur.' displayed under the refus toast alongside the 'Espace Vendeur' header — known non-blocking state per E1's note, kept as LOW.

Greeting line regex-captured as 'Bonjour . Je suis Kairos...' — the token 'Sara' is present elsewhere in the page body (so greeting check passes) but the visible salutation may render with an empty prenom in some viewport. Non-blocking; suggest E1 verifies the greeting template uses profile.prenom fallback.

action_items: (LOW) Investigate /app cockpit greeting: ensure 'Bonjour {prenom}' correctly renders 'Bonjour Sara' — currently the salutation phrase captured shows an empty prenom slot even though Sara is onboarded.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3269 lines — should be split into modules (auth, admin, vendeur, state) for maintainability.
PATCH /admin/utilisateurs/{user_id}/role accepts nouveau_role as query param (not Pydantic body) — consider request body validation for stronger input validation.
Onboarding.jsx: PLANS default is now 'essentielle' (fix confirmed). Consider guarding UI with `PLANS.find(...)?.name || plan` to be defensive against future key renames.
test_credentials: sara@zayado.fr/SaraTest2026!, admin.test@zayado.fr/AdminTest2026!, test.radar@zayado.fr/TestRadar2026! (all validated). Register works with any new unique email + 8+ char password.
seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway account per run via /api/auth/register (marie.test.<uuid>@zayado.fr) — no cleanup implemented; email is unique so no collisions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend port 8001 via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://radar-ui.preview.emergentagent.com). Frontend stores JWT in localStorage under 'kairos_access_token'. Without token, API falls back to DEMO_USER_ID shared account — always pass Bearer token for isolation tests. Admin console is a separate build flavor (REACT_APP_FLAVOR=console) not routed here — only its API is testable in this preview. Pytest file already covers register/state isolation, duplicate register 409, admin security 401/403/200, and seed logins.
rca of the issue: Both original bugs were resolved before this iteration: (1) POST /auth/register no longer injects 'Camille' — new VisionProfile is created with prenom='' (server.py L830-831). (2) Onboarding.jsx L32 now defaults `plan` state to 'essentielle' (a valid PLANS key), so `PLANS.find(p => p.key === plan)?.name` resolves to 'Essentielle' at step 8 instead of undefined. Both fixes verified end-to-end (backend pytest + Playwright UI walk-through).
